overview: The Cursed Halls are the necrotic underbelly of Ssraeshza Temple.
details: Here lie the ancient Shissar who refused death, bound by venom curses and ritual magic. Their tombs pulse with necrotic energy, and cursed guardians enforce Ssraeshza’s eternal tyranny.
hooks: A necrotic tomb cracks open, releasing cursed Shissar.
Venom‑bound undead rise during a ritual surge.
A serpent hierophant attempts to resurrect an ancient Shissar noble.
The Cursed Hierophant awakens to purge intruders.
